newCategoryDesc: Add a new category for transactions
name: Name
title: Title
editCategoryDesc: Edit or add an expense category
loginError: Login failed. Please check your credentials
cashFlowDesc: Income and expenses over the last months
financePreferencesDescription: Choose how financial accounts appear to you.
showBusinessAccountDescription: Show or hide the business account in the selector and views. This does not change your permissions or delete data.
manualAdjustmentHelp: For yields or corrections: adds to the goal balance/objective, does not count toward the month's realized amount and creates no account transaction.
goalAccountHelp: This goal will be linked to {account}.
createFirstGoal: Create a fixed monthly goal or one based on a percentage of income.

newGoalDescription: Set how much you want to allocate each month to a goal.
noProjectionData: There is no data to chart.
noProjectionItems: No expected transactions for this period.
investmentProjectionHelp: Estimated from the monthly average of recent months with contributions (up to 3)
livingCostHelp: Average essential expenses over the last {months} months
livingCostInsufficient: Keep using the system so we can calculate your living cost. We need at least 3 full months of essential expenses.
reserveGoalHelp: Uses this goal's accumulated amount to calculate the months of reserve on the dashboard.
initialBalanceHelp: How much you already have saved for this goal.
initialBalanceLocked: The initial balance can only be set while the goal has no contributions.
objectiveHelp: Total amount you want to reach (optional).
createAccountFirst: Create an account to view financial data and set goals.
membersDescription: Invite people to share this account. Members with access can view and edit all account data.
sharedAccountSelectHelp: Choose the account you want to manage.
inviteMemberDesc: We'll email a link to accept the invitation. The link expires in 7 days.
cancelInviteDesc: The sent link will stop working.
removeMemberDesc: The member will lose access to this account.
sharedAccountReadOnly: You are a member of this account. Only the owner can manage invitations.
incomingInvitesDesc: Invitations to share other people's accounts.
sharedInviteReceivedDesc: Accept to view and edit the data in this account.
newTransactionDesc: Add a new transaction to the active account.
pendingTransactionHelp: The transaction does not affect the balance until it is confirmed.
categoryDirectionHelp: Income categories do not use a goal; expense categories use a percentage goal.
categoryGoalHelp: Desired spending percentage for this category.
pendingConfirmFailed: Could not confirm the pending item
confirmValueHelp: You can adjust the value before confirming.
confirmValueInvalid: Enter a value greater than zero.
confirmRecurrenceHelp: The value applies only to this occurrence; the recurrence keeps its original value.
recurrenceCategorySyncHint: The category is also updated on the recurrence and on pending occurrences. Confirmed ones keep their history.
noPendingItems: No pending items for this period.
goalEndDateHelp: Leave empty to repeat the goal every month.
goalEndBeforeStart: End date cannot be before start date.
importStatementDesc: Read a CSV or OFX file, validate the rows and import the transactions into the selected account.
reviewImportsDesc: Approve or discard imported transactions that are awaiting review.
importAccountRequired: Select an account before choosing the file.
importFileHelp: Choose a CSV or OFX file exported from your bank. If the statement is only available as PDF, convert it to OFX before importing. The file is read in the browser; only valid rows are sent for preview.
importChooseFile: Choose a CSV or OFX file
importFormats: CSV or OFX · up to 1,000 rows per import
importPdfHint: Bank statements are usually exported as PDF. Convert it to OFX and import it here.
importPdfDetectedDesc: {file} cannot be imported directly. Convert the PDF to OFX with the external converter and choose the converted file.
importFileTooLarge: The file exceeds the 5 MB limit.
importPreviewFailed: Could not generate the statement preview
importLimitReached: Limit of {count} rows per import; the excess was ignored.
importInvalidHelp: {count} invalid row(s) will be ignored. Fix the file and try again if you need to import them.

importParseError.noTransactions: No transactions were found in the file.

importReviewHelp: Imported transactions stay in Review status until you approve or discard them.
importReviewLoadFailed: Could not load the transactions under review
categoryGoalsDesc: Expected by goal (%) and realized this month. Categories without transactions are hidden.
categoryGoalsEmpty: No expense category has transactions this month.
categoryGoalNoIncome: No income this month to compare
classificationShareDesc: Share of the month's income in each classification.
classificationShareNoIncome: No income this month to calculate the share.
googleLoginFailed: Could not sign in with Google. If you don't have an account yet, create one first.
registerDescription: Sign up to organize your finances.
registerSuccessDescription: We sent a confirmation email to {email}. Confirm it before signing in.
landingTitle: Accounts, spending and goals in one place
landingDescription: Record transactions, track recurrences and project your balance for the coming months. Monthly and per-category goals so you know exactly where your money goes.
landingFeaturesTitle: Everything you need to organize the month
landingFeatureAccountsDescription: Keep personal and business money apart and switch accounts without losing context.
landingFeatureTransactionsDescription: Classify income and expenses, import statements and track every entry.
landingFeatureGoalsDescription: Set monthly and per-category goals and compare expected with realized.
landingFeatureProjectionDescription: Project the next 30, 90 or 180 days based on recurrences and pending items.
landingCtaDescription: Create your free account and follow everything in a single dashboard.
cardModalDesc: A card is a payment method linked to this account.
cardInitialBalanceHelp: Optional. Creates a confirmed card purchase dated today, so it lands in the current open invoice. Use it to bring what you already owe on the card.
cardLimitHelp: Optional. Informational: usage does not block purchases.
cardCycleHelp: Purchases on the closing day belong to the invoice. The due date is the first day after closing.
openInvoicesHelp: Unpaid card purchases (confirmed purchases up to today minus payments).
invoicesDesc: Card cycles with status, totals and payments.
invoiceCyclePreview: Invoice estimated from the card closing and due days.
invoicePaymentHelp: The payment is recorded as a cash outflow without category. Partial payments are allowed.
invoicePaymentExceeds: The value cannot exceed the invoice remaining amount.
invoicePendingPurchasesHelp: Confirm or delete pending purchases before paying the invoice.
deleteInvoicePaymentDesc: The {value} payment will be removed and the invoice reopened.
deleteInvoicePaymentFromListDesc: The payment will be removed and the invoice reopened. It cannot be deleted through transaction CRUD.
cardDeleteFailed: Could not delete the card. Check for open invoices.
deleteCardDesc: The card "{name}" will be removed. Only cards without open invoices can be deleted.
noCardsYet: No cards in this account yet.
cardPurchaseHelp: The purchase goes to the card invoice and leaves cash when the invoice is paid.
recurrenceCardHelp: Occurrences are created as card purchases.
newTransferDesc: Move money between two accounts. Not income or expense.
editTransferDesc: Change value, date and title; source and destination stay the same.
transferSameAccount: Choose a destination account different from the source.
transferTitleHelp: Optional. Shown on both legs of the transfer.
transferEditScopeHelp: Both legs are updated together. To change source/destination, create a new transfer.
transferNeedsTwoAccounts: You need at least two accounts.
deleteTransferDesc: Both legs (outflow and inflow) will be removed.
